tasks.subject: Task 6: RAWG → IGDB resolver
tasks.description:
lib/igdb/resolver.ts exports resolveIgdbIds(games): Steam-appid bucket via single /external_games call; non-Steam bucket via per-game /games name+year query at concurrency 4. Returns Map<rawgId, {igdbId, steamAppid}>.

tasks.subject: Task 7: IGDB backfill script (build + run)
tasks.description:
scripts/backfill-igdb.ts: select games where igdb_resolved_at IS NULL, batch 500/request, resolve via resolver.ts, fetch all 4 facets in one /games call, normalize, write to columns + side-effect-fill steam_appid. Honors BACKFILL_LIMIT/DRY_RUN. Run dry-run smoke then full backfill (~25min).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/backfill-igdb.ts"], "verifyCommand": "BACKFILL_LIMIT=5 BACKFILL_DRY_RUN=1 pnpm tsx --env-file=.env scripts/backfill-igdb.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["smoke run on 5 games passes", "full backfill achieves >=90% mechanics coverage", "unresolved games marked with igdb_resolved_at=NOW(), igdb_id=NULL"]}
```
